name: What causes black spots on walls?

mainEntity.name: What causes black spots on walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black spots on walls are commonly caused by mold growth. Mold thrives in damp, humid conditions and often appears in areas with poor ventilation, water leaks, or condensation. Common locations include bathrooms, kitchens, basements, and behind furniture. Identifying the underlying moisture source is crucial for effective remediation, as simply cleaning the surface will not prevent recurrence if the moisture problem persists.
acceptedAnswer.description: Black spots on walls are typically caused by mold growth, which thrives in damp, humid environments due to issues like leaks or poor ventilation.
